scope: Normal authenticated Hub UI; no publishing, scheduling, customer messages or credential changes.
audit_acceptance: One initial live audit per saved draft after deployment; record all results, including unavailable or flagged.
No manual score override, repeated calls to obtain a pass, caption weakening, or hidden change to the approved design.
Successful result retains seven criteria, separate optional suggestions, actual source coverage and canonical emblem reference hash.
Read and assess every finding against the actual complete carousel and owner instruction; schema-valid output alone is not semantic acceptance.
All three drafts remain unscheduled and unpublished. Public approval is separate.
other_acceptance: Photos exact asset review loads the actual catalog and existing review state; opt-in is not preselected for a new record.
Owner operator marketing status displays observed heartbeat timestamps, not an unsupported current-running or delivery claim.
Registry and planner positive attachment behavior has local real-SQLite evidence; do not claim live automatic reuse without an actual approved asset and saved linked output.
limitations: Three owner drafts do not establish general model accuracy. Controlled adversarial visual benchmark remains open. No autonomous rendering or channel-delivery claim follows from these checks.
